segments.text: One live request crosses four governed surfaces: Functions, API Management, ACA Sandbox, and Application Insights.

This is the deployed Hosted Skills chat UI, not a reconstruction. One prompt asks Microsoft Learn for grounding and issues two local shell calls. Expanding the live bubble shows all three calls while typed inventory proves one sandbox is running. The answer then returns the Learn takeaway and both safe markers.

Both local calls share that fresh invocation sandbox and queue safely through its file journal. The twenty-five second holds make the running state visible; they are not performance measurements. After the response, an independent inventory check returns zero with no operator cleanup.

Application Insights exposes the native Agent Trace experience. This retained live run shows the agent span, two model calls, Azure Container Apps sandbox operations, and the file journal. Account, operation, resource, and sandbox identifiers are redacted.

The new capture run is correlated separately because it is not yet indexed as an invoke-agent row in the preview blade. Its sixty-eight point eight one second runtime trace still contains model planning and synthesis, Microsoft Learn MCP, sandbox creation, both queued journal executions, cleanup, and deletion.

The same UTC window shows two successful model posts and five successful MCP posts through the AI Gateway. The live policies enforce backend routing, token governance, rate limits, streaming, W three C correlation, and zero body capture.

The bounded capture returned HTTP two hundred and inventory zero. In the latest complete twenty-one-run qualification from September fifth, runtime remained thirty-five point five percent below baseline with zero errors. Seventeen pre-acceptance delete stalls were recovered by bounded exact-ID provider deletion, and final inventory was zero after every stage.
Functions orchestrates. API Management governs. ACA Sandbox isolates. Application Insights proves the live path and cleanup.
